title: Israeli Drone Strike Near Muscat School Kills Two in Al-Tuffah, Gaza City
detail: An Israeli combat drone struck a group of Palestinians near the Muscat school in the al-Tuffah neighborhood, northeast of Gaza City, on the evening of Tuesday, September 22, 2026, killing two people and wounding three others, including a child. WAFA reported Israeli occupation forces bombed the group directly; the IDF had not commented on the strike as of publication. The strike came amid a broader wave of at least eleven documented ceasefire violations that morning, with drones flying intensively at low altitude over Gaza City and artillery shelling eastern districts.

media.caption: Continued Israeli ceasefire violations across Gaza, Sep 22, 2026

title: Israeli Shelling Kills Adham Sobhi Ziyara Near Al-Nafaq Street, East Gaza City
detail: Late on Tuesday night, September 22, 2026, an Israeli shelling attack struck a group of Palestinians near al-Nafaq Street, east of Gaza City, killing Adham Sobhi Ziyara and wounding three others. The strike was one of several reported that night as Israeli forces shelled eastern Gaza City and warplanes carried out additional airstrikes in the eastern parts of the Tuffah neighborhood.

media.caption: Continued Israeli ceasefire violations across Gaza, Sep 22, 2026
